item.title: Saitama Super Arena: Japan's Massive Multi-Purpose Venue — Guide
item.description: Saitama Super Arena is one of the largest multi-purpose indoor arenas in Asia, its distinctive design featuring a movable main stand that allows the venue to reconfigure between a compact arena setting and a massive stadium-style space seating up to roughly 37,000. Since opening in 2000, it has hosted major international concerts, world championship sporting events, conventions and the wrestling and basketball events of the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, making it a key stop for visitors attending large-scale events near Tokyo.
